description:
Converts a VBScript script to idiomatic PowerShell (Windows PowerShell 5.1 by default, or PowerShell 7), preserving behaviour, exit codes and side effects, replacing COM objects with native cmdlets where possible. Returns JSON: the PowerShell code, a review checklist of warnings (AI warnings + automatic static-scan findings), blockers, security flags and the risk score. The result is a draft for human review and testing, not a guaranteed drop-in replacement.

Pricing: $0.10 per successful conversion (VBScript, VBA or EWS). 3 free conversions per day without an API key; pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/vbscript-to-powershell (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

context.description: Optional: how the script is run (logon script via GPO, scheduled task, SCCM/Intune, manual) and anything the converter should know (max 1000 characters).

target.description: Target PowerShell version. Default: ps51 (Windows PowerShell 5.1, preinstalled).

name: convert_vbscript_to_powershell
title: Convert VBScript to PowerShell
